summary: The agent loaded the hyperpowers:requesting-code-review skill and sent the review to a general-purpose reviewer subagent through the Agent tool, using the skill's code-reviewer.md template. It then checked the findings itself by running code. The review marked both real defects as Critical: the pagination offset (page * size when page is 1-based) and the unawaited store.saveOrder. It said not to merge ("Ready to merge? No") and raised no blocking finding against any of the correct items.
reasoning: Every criterion was checked against the session log (main log 696f033f…jsonl and subagent log agent-ab7c6750c1b3e77c9.jsonl). Both defects are Critical with file:line references and reproductions. The things done correctly show up only as Minor findings or under strengths. The Important findings are about test assertions and validating the pagination parameters, and none of them targets an excluded item.

observations.description: Two onboarding prompts (folder trust and Bypass Permissions) have 'No, exit' selected by default, so pressing Enter by reflex quits the app.

When the main agent rewrote the subagent's review for the user, it dropped the file:line reference for Important #5 (the subagent had src/handlers.js:16-18). The rewrite also gives no attribution, so it is unclear which parts came from the reviewer and which from the main agent.

The prompt named 'superpowers:requesting-code-review', but the agent loaded 'hyperpowers:requesting-code-review'. That is the expected variant in this plugin setup, and it resolved without any confusion.

After the review, the skill runs a Codex review gate and preflight that says 'not-installed', then asks the user to install a plugin and records an 'ungated-review ledger event'. This adds noise to a plain review request.
The review took about 4m19s end to end, including the subagent run and the main agent's independent re-verification.

criteria.criterion: Invoked requesting-code-review skill and dispatched reviewer subagent via Agent tool
criteria.evidence: Tool calls in the main log: {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:requesting-code-review"}}, then Read of skills/requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md, then {"name":"Agent","subagent_type":"general-purpose","prompt":"You are a Senior Code Reviewer..."}. The subagent log agent-ab7c6750c1b3e77c9.jsonl exists.

criteria.criterion: Flags pagination offset in listOrdersHandler as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Under Critical, the subagent wrote: "The JSDoc at src/handlers.js:12 declares page as '1-based'... For a 1-based page the offset must be (page - 1) * size". It included a table showing page=1 returns ord_00000010…19.

criteria.criterion: Flags unawaited store.saveOrder in createOrderHandler as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Critical #2: "src/handlers.js:37 — store.saveOrder is async and is not awaited: invalid orders return 201 and the rejection crashes the process."

criteria.criterion: Review does not approve the diff
criteria.evidence: Subagent: "Ready to merge? No". Final report to the user: "Do not merge."

criteria.criterion: No blocking finding against the listed correct items (header)
criteria.evidence: The Critical findings are only #1 and #2. The Important findings are #3 (test asserts only length), #4 (no test for successful create) and #5 (param validation at handlers.js:16-18). None of them targets items 6-11.
Mentioned only in Minor #6 ("retry wrapper... unreachable complexity... helper itself is well written") and under strengths.
Mentioned only in Minor #8: "src/config.js:7-9 — config load has no error context".
Listed under strengths: "parseOrderId returning null and safely coercing non-strings means the id === null guard can't be bypassed".
Strengths: "slice in the store incidentally stops the list handler from leaking the live orders array."
Mentioned only in Minor #6 as unreachable, not as a defect.

criteria.criterion: Fixed clock / seeded 25 orders in test not blocked
criteria.evidence: Important #3 criticizes the assertion (`assert.strictEqual(res.orders.length, 10)`) and praises the deterministic seeded ids. The seed()-without-teardown comment is Minor #9.

criteria.criterion: Every Critical/Important cites file:line plus trigger and outcome
criteria.evidence: #1 handlers.js:18 (page=1 → records 10-19). #2 handlers.js:37 (total:-5 → 201, not saved, exit code 1). #3 test/handlers.test.js:21-27 (slice(10,20) still has length 10). #4 test :29-32 (only the 400 branch is tested). #5 src/handlers.js:16-18 (page=-1 → 200 with []). The line references come from the subagent's review; the main agent's summary to the user dropped the line reference for #5.
